cohort: The study included 70 pregnant women aged 17-41 years with COVID-19 who were hospitalized from early March to late April 2020 in Guilan, Iran.
finding: The most common symptoms of COVID-19 in pregnant women were fever, cough and shortness of breath, and the most common laboratory finding in infected mothers was lymphopenia.
mod_finding: Complications of pregnancy and childbirth in women included an increase in cesarean delivery.
